 P7 Drive
 Print 
 P7 Drive
 P7 Drive - YAI
 5 - 500 HP
 The P7 was designed for variable torque applications like Fans and Centrifugal Pumps. It was supplied with V/f control and Normal Duty overload rating of 110% for one minute.
 The P7 Drive is a legacy product no longer promoted in the Americas.

 P7 Drive - Overview
 P7 Standard Drives - 5-500HP, 208-230/240 and 480V, 3-phase1 input, NEMA 1 or protected chassis enclosure
